record.label: Gaussian mixed degree-6 quotient shell
record.summary: The exact mixed Hermite (1,2,3) shell is disjoint from the incumbent CP3 (1,1,2) birth, and its factor-36 diagram law plus repeated-plane quotient were verified exactly. On rank0, however, it changes raw MSE only from 2.856783180e-8 to 2.854296094e-8. Late-q correlation is 0.02312 and projected adjusted score is 1.210095886e-8 at 932,289,050,615 FLOPs, above the live target. Receipt SHA-256 3458f0487b618805cd112b6ee29362d2f5266efb5fff64759b72dc08f9fb3e38.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed for the complete mixed-D6 (1,2,3) quotient shell by its frozen rank-0 source/score gate; this does not claim the distinct expensive (2,2,2) triangle shell is evaluated.
